plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Spec-driven building for one person: genesis, mocks and prototype to find what to build, plan with the strong model, then run or fan out builders that take each spec to merged in its own worktree behind your test command

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow (/git:commit), a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup (/git:merge), and an idempotent per-spec worktree entry (/git:enter-worktree)

plugins.name: style
plugins.description: Cross-machine communication style — ships an output style with outcome-first, emoji-anchored response rules that auto-applies wherever the plugin is enabled, replacing per-machine CLAUDE.md edits
